verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent tracing documents end-to-end agent run traces with an AI Spans view, tool calls and handoffs. It groups related AI spans into chat sessions via `gen_ai.conversation.id`, which some integrations set automatically and which `set_conversation_id()` also sets, surfaced in a Conversations view. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the parent/child span nesting hierarchy for multi-step runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: **Traces** shows end-to-end agent runs and the application work around them.
Click on any trace to open the [AI Spans view](#ai-spans-view) in Explore → Traces.
Sentry uses the `gen_ai.conversation.id` attribute to group related AI spans, and some SDK integrations set it automatically.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
